_comment: Mutation testing for the context interviews (docs/architecture/context-interviews.md): reading a transcript (txt/docx/vtt/srt), the one check every claim passes (verbatim quote, period dates, attribute keys, confidence), the prompt and reply schema, the reply check and repair round, splitting and de-duplicating, matching a spoken name to the interviewee / an account / a first name the context knows, the fixed role-deduction rules, deciding a claim (description append, attribute write, Accountable conflict, Responsible add) and the routes with their reader narrowing. WHY THESE FILES: every failure here is silent -- a quote check one step too loose lets a claim rest on words nobody said, a deduction rule inverted makes the backup the owner, a first-name match too eager points a role at the wrong colleague, a reader narrowing dropped shows unreviewed claims to a business reader. Scoped like the sibling API configs: these files plus their own unit tests, which are self-contained (no repository paths outside the sandbox, no PostgreSQL). MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling configs -- so the SQL in store.js / subjects.js / decide.js is not mutated and stays the contract test's job (contract-tests/contextInterviews.contract.test.js). Run: cd app/api && npm run test:mutation:contextinterviews NOT YET MEASURED: this config ships with the feature; break is deliberately absent until a first run measures a score.
